members.name: value
members.description: The wrapper is exactly a native textarea with React.ComponentProps<textarea>. value/defaultValue, name, required, disabled, readOnly, maxLength, rows and onChange are native props. It adds field-sizing-content and a minimum height, not autosave, rich text, a submit-on-Enter handler or a new value callback.

events.name: onChange
events.description: Actual React native change handler, with currentTarget.value/selectedOptions. Not a CustomEvent or cancellable BaseUI value transaction.
